title: OCHA: Drone Strikes Hit Fuel Station in El Obeid, Trucks on Darfur Roads
detail: OCHA's latest situation update reported drone strikes hitting a fuel station in Al Malaja, El Obeid, alongside separate strikes on trucks along the El Fasher-Um Kadada road (North Darfur) and in Kubum town (South Darfur), with the operator unattributed in OCHA's reporting. Cholera continued to spread: West Kordofan recorded 6 additional suspected cases and 2 deaths, while North Kordofan's Gharb Bara locality recorded 32 additional suspected cases. Separately, a Sudanese government minister said the war has 'profoundly reshaped' the nation's demography, citing roughly 600,000 new arrivals in Chad since March 2023 and Chad's total of 935,870 registered Sudanese refugees.

sources.name: AllAfrica (OCHA republication) — Sudan humanitarian situation update
Al Jazeera — Sudanese minister says war has 'profoundly reshaped' nation's demography

media.caption: OCHA reported continued drone strikes on El Obeid and Darfur roads on July 16, 2026, as a Sudanese minister said the war has reshaped the country's demography via mass displacement to Chad.
